Has the agent edit code in the user's repo, run the repository's own test/build/typecheck/lint commands (e.g. npm test, pytest, `npx tsc --noEmit`, SKILL.md:204-207), and make local git commits per slice (SKILL.md:41, 209). Rated low: these are standard, local, reversible development actions on the user's own task; there is no push, merge, deploy, install, or credential use. Note that `npx` can fetch a package if it is not already installed locally.
